where_each_number_comes_from.max_price, property types: Buy box set by Andrew 2026-11-21: up to $5,000,000; retail (strip centers, retail). The scanner also leaves out land, pad sites and business-only sales.
where_each_number_comes_from.vacancy_credit_loss: Estimate: a first-pass haircut on the broker's NOI, not a market figure.
where_each_number_comes_from.management_pct: Estimate: 0 because management is usually billed back to tenants in NNN retail; raise it for gross leases.
where_each_number_comes_from.reserves_psf: Estimate: placeholder for roof, parking lot and other capital reserves.
where_each_number_comes_from.loan.rate: Verify: placeholder until a lender quote. Replace with the firm's current term sheet.
where_each_number_comes_from.loan.ltv, loan.amort_years, first_pass.m: Estimate: common bank terms for small retail, to replace with the firm's lender terms.
where_each_number_comes_from.target_cap: Estimate: the firm's going-in return hurdle, to set.
where_each_number_comes_from.unpriced_max_sf: Estimate: unpriced listings larger than this are assumed to ask more than the max price.
